answer: Sample first. Each epoch, pull a random slice of submissions and re-run the tasks from scratch. Stamp every entry with a fresh nonce so a replay cannot count as new work. Group attestations by origin subnet, then tax any cluster that only votes for itself. What this cannot do: stop an operator who pays real workers spread across many subnets, and it cannot tell whether a task was done well, only that it was done. That is thin pigment. A funded farm still bends the system like a willow. The audit only gives honest agents a haven from free riders.
